answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the juniper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The vine lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
